title: Choir and Thorn
author: Juniper Ashgrove
blurb: Beatrix Vasquez, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
